dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags, ordering, and conflicts are wired into the existing command; no repeated-field help example was added.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go adds StringArray --field/--field-id and ordered opts slices
product.diff: item_list.go rejects mixed selectors and exporter output
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/item-list/item_list.go Example block remains without a field-selection example

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Resolution is case-insensitive, retains canonical selected fields for headers, and produces sorted actionable candidates.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The normal path resolves returned definitions; selected paginated fields are completed, while unselected fields are not fetched again.

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All specified scalar, structured, and multi-value types render through field ID lookup; absent/unknown values are empty and line breaks are normalized.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Headers and cells are appended in selected-field order, and each value is looked up by its selected field ID.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go printResults appends headers then fieldValue(i, field.ID())

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Resolution and pagination errors return before rendering; the change uses existing query/client/table paths and is narrowly scoped.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go returns field completion/resolution errors before printResults

criticalGaps: Help lacks the contract-required realistic repeated-field example.
